Gideon, the first report in #inc-vtg-hartford was your post at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**: gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

From the channel, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard while the kiosks were down. Mateo reported at 11:03 AM that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07 AM.

The ticket SUP-5380 log has an earlier entry at 08:12 on 3 Aug: "Rebot failed; drivers queueing. Checking conn. now." I can't see who wrote that entry, so check it before you treat it as the first report for the postmortem.
